meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Framework for computational fluid dynamics simulations using Python. Use when running fluid dynamics simulations including Navier-Stokes equations (2D/3D), shallow water equations, stratified flows, or when analyzing turbulence, vortex dynamics, or geophysical flows. Provides pseudospectral methods with FFT, HPC support, and comprehensive output analysis.

copy.tagline: 用Python运行流体动力学模拟

copy.tagline_en: Run fluid dynamics simulations with Python
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run CFD simulations or study fluid mechanics

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以编写 Python 代码来配置和运行流体动力学模拟，包括 2D/3D 纳维-斯托克斯方程、浅水方程和分层流。它使用伪谱方法和 FFT，支持 MPI 并行计算，并能自动保存结果供分析。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行流体动力学模拟，例如研究湍流、涡旋动力学或地球物理流时触发。
howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write Python code to configure and run fluid dynamics simulations, including 2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, and stratified flows. It uses pseudospectral methods with FFT, supports MPI parallelization, and automatically saves results for analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to perform fluid dynamics simulations, such as studying turbulence, vortex dynamics, or geophysical flows.

say_en.text: Help me simulate 2D turbulence with fluidsim, grid 256x256, viscosity 1e-3.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a complete Python script and explain steps.

say_en.text: Run a stratified flow simulation with fluidsim, set Brunt-Väisälä frequency to 2.0.
say_en.note: Claude will configure parameters and output code.
